wikitext:

[[South Africa]] has a number of [[college]]s. There two types of public colleges in [[South Africa]], public and private colleges. All accredited colleges must be registered. Public and private colleges are registered by the [[Department of Higher Education and Training]] but only private colleges can be registered by [[Matriculation in South Africa|Umalusi]].

There are two types of public colleges: Further Education and Training (FET) and Technical and [[Vocational education|Vocational Education and Training]] (TVET) colleges.<ref>{{Cite web |author=Staff Reporter |date=2019-02-01 |title=Exploring FETs and TVETs as viable alternatives |url=https://mg.co.za/article/2019-02-01-00-exploring-fets-and-tvets-as-viable-alternatives/ |access-date=2025-01-08 |website=The Mail & Guardian |language=en-ZA}}</ref> [[South Africa]]'s youth, especially those in [[rural area]]s and [[township]]s tend to enroll at [[college]]s at they are more accessible, affordable and they focus on practical learning.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2024-04-18 |title=Top 15 TVET Colleges in South Africa {{!}} FundiConnect |url=https://fundiconnect.co.za/top-15-tvet-colleges-in-south-africa/#elementor-toc__heading-anchor-0 |access-date=2025-01-09 |language=en-US}}</ref>
